Definition
[$\kappa $-noncollapsed metric] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0101 1. ch19:19.1\group Noncollapsing

A metric $\hat g$ is $\kappa $-noncollapsed below scale $\rho $ if every ball $B(x,r)$ with $r<\rho $ and $|\Rm |\le r^{-2}$ satisfies \[ \frac{\Vol _{\hat g}B(x,r)}{r^n}\ge \kappa . \] The condition at scale $\infty $ means all scales; a Ricci flow is $\kappa $-noncollapsed when every time slice has the property.
